summary: Mostly no. Across 1h, 4h and daily, only Base 36, pump 3%, crack 5% on 1h carried an edge that held. It was 0.95% ahead of random entries after 20 candles and held without its strongest episode. That result came from uptrends: while the pair was below its 200-day SMA, the same setting showed nothing.

verdicts.use: Deep crack below the base on 1h (Base 36, pump 3%, crack 5%)
verdicts.text: Price ran 0.95% ahead of random entries 20 candles later. It held without its strongest episode and at 50 candles, but not at 10 or 100.

verdicts.use: Shallow crack below the base on 1h (crack 1% or 3%)
verdicts.text: With crack 1% or 3%, on Base 36 or Base 72, price did no better than after random candles on 1h.

verdicts.use: Bigger pump before the base on 1h (pump 5%, crack 3%)
verdicts.text: Price ran 0.69% ahead of random entries, but only because of signals on Feb 28, 2021. Without them the result is chance.
No setting beat or trailed random entries on 4h when the three pairs are pooled.
No setting beat random on daily candles. Each pair alone, and the uptrend regime, had too few episodes to judge.

notes: On 1h, Base 36, pump 3%, crack 5% gave 2,317 entries in 263 separate moves. After 20 candles they were 0.95% ahead of random entries, above a luck band that topped out at 0.63%. The gap held without its strongest episode, 18 entries on Feb 28, 2021, and it showed at 50 candles too. At 10 and 100 candles it was inside the band.

No single pair carries that result. On BTC, ETH and SOL taken alone, it rests on one episode each: Feb 5–6, 2026 for BTC, May 23, 2021 for ETH and Feb 28, 2021 for SOL. Without that episode each pair falls back to chance. The edge only shows when the three pairs are pooled.

The uptrend regime carries the result. While the pair closed above its 200-day SMA, crack 5% entries were 1.97% ahead of random uptrend candles, and that held without the strongest episode. Below the SMA they were 0.25% ahead, inside the luck band, on about one and a half times as many entries. Crack 3% follows the same pattern: 1.07% ahead in uptrends, but fragile, and nothing in downtrends.

A shallower crack fires far more often and shows nothing. Base 36, pump 1%, crack 1% on 1h entered about five times as often as crack 5%, and it was 0.1% ahead of random entries, inside the band. Crack 3% on Base 36 or Base 72 also landed inside the band. Pump 5%, crack 3% was 0.69% ahead, but that gap disappears without signals on Feb 28, 2021.

On 4h, every setting landed inside the luck band when pooled. In downtrends, Base 36, pump 1%, crack 1% did 1.07% worse than random 20 candles later. It held without its strongest stretch, signals on May 6–13, 2022, during the Terra collapse, and it also showed at 10 candles. On ETH alone, every 4h setting looked worse only because of signals between Jun 10 and Jun 19, 2022. On daily, no setting had enough episodes on any one pair to judge.

The only shape worth testing is a 5% crack on 1h, used as a filter alongside a trend condition such as price above the 200-day SMA. The gap showed at 20 and 50 candles, not at 10, so a take profit that closes most deals within 10 candles would not catch it. On 4h in downtrends, price did worse than random after shallow cracks, so expect the DCA orders to fill there. On 4h and daily these settings add no timing, which is a reason to leave them out.
